protocol.purpose: Bounded dense-action teacher/control pilot following measured coverage and ranking failures; not a repetition of stage2

train.states_from: first 16 original IDs per size from saved stage2/train snapshots; reuse existing seed71 action costs

protocol.actions: every current undirected edge; conventional reference last; no label-driven state/action filtering
protocol.existing_branch_reuse: all compatible saved seed71 reference/candidate costs reused; count reused actions separately; only missing edges execute new rollouts
protocol.batching: bucket by node count so all action tensors in a batch have the same size
protocol.loss: same unweighted MSE pp +0.1 logistic ranking on non-tied same-state pairs as stage2; no label balancing or threshold tuning in this pilot
protocol.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation top1 regret; reference wins score ties; earlier checkpoint wins metric ties
protocol.ensemble: arithmetic mean of each model's predeclared three seeds; never pick a seed by validation gain
protocol.heldout_policy: freeze all checkpoints before heldout metrics; score old stage2 models as transfer references; no prompts, retraining or threshold selection from heldout outcomes
protocol.interpretation: Changed action coverage and instance count are not an isolated causal ablation of dense labels; compare all three new models on the same pilot data and disclose limitations
